name: Third Silence
designation_status: Provisional Union translation of a Shadow Fleet term; true name unknown.

custody.primary: Joint Union Marshal evidence and Sentinel hazardous-material custody
custody.judicial: Field Court preservation and observation order
custody.observation: Court-appointed observers and isolated technical monitoring
custody.shadow_claim: Shadow personnel continue to assert a custodial and operational interest in the artifact.

canon_observations: Carried by a Shadow Fleet boarding squad inside the concealed vessel.
Marked by a divided-circle symbol with three points and a horizontal dividing line.
Altered or interrupted active material behavior in nearby hull, armor, and bodies.
Could suppress visible propagation of the black material when applied to an affected body or suit.
Produced effects compatible with the improvised alternating fields generated by Ranger Span drones and Sentinel shield systems.
Was described by Shadow personnel as one of three commands or Silences.
Was transported toward a compatible interface near the vessel's central phenomenon.
Maelin Saye partially engaged the artifact with two interface contacts while resisting full mechanical seating.
The partial engagement halted observed material flow across mapped cells and briefly exposed nested internal segmentation, thousands of restraint frames, and extended light patterns or vectors.
The artifact completed at least one pulse before Tessa Korr cut it free with a Spatha Moderna.
The pulse coincided with the system-wide sensor flare that exposed Shadow Fleet concealment and additional anomalous returns.
The artifact was recovered damaged but functional, with one Ranger Span drone fused to its casing.
staging_hypotheses: The artifact is one of three complete locks required to contain the dark star.
The artifact's function is definitively material separation across a distributed vessel or consciousness.
Full engagement would safely restore containment.
Partial engagement caused an intentional transmission beyond the Lethan system.
The light patterns observed during activation are routes, connections, receivers, or other related Dark Star structures.
The Shadow Fleet created the artifact.
The Kallis Foundry data core is a replacement or copy of another Silence.
The fused Span drone contains recoverable information beyond the surviving image fragment.
symbol_boundary: The divided-circle and three-point motif is an observed family of symbols. Variations in line orientation appear associated with distinct artifact or command functions, but exact semantics remain STAGING.
promotion_pass: Dark Star Narrative Reconciliation Pass — 2026-07-22; Third Silence Narrative Audit — 2026-07-22
description: An artifact recovered from the Dark Star encounter; damaged but functional, held in joint Union custody aboard the Judicator Prime flagship in a hardened containment chamber shared by Marshal evidence officers, Sentinel specialists, and science staff.
reconciliation_note: Reconciled 2026-07-21 from committed Dark Star arc canon (narrative v1.1 + AAR + event_dark_star_incident). Derivation from established canon, additive; prior fields preserved.
